scenes.title: Why can't Emma see PAY-3?
scenes.caption: The most common Jira admin ticket
scenes.narration: Every Jira admin gets this ticket: why can't Emma see PAY-3? Tracing schemes, roles, groups and security levels by hand takes hours. Config Doctor answers in seconds, and proves it.

scenes.title: Access Explainer
scenes.caption: Verdict, evidence chain, simulated fix, Jira's own check
scenes.narration: In Rovo, I pick the Config Doctor agent and ask: why can't Emma Paris see PAY-3? The answer comes from a deterministic Forge action that reads the permission scheme, roles, groups and issue security, not from the model's guesswork. Verdict: blocked by the issue security level. The evidence chain shows Emma passes the permission scheme, through group cd-contractors-2024 in role CD Developers, but the level Internal only admits only cd-staff-hq. The fix, adding her to that group, is simulated first, with its blast radius. And Jira's own permission check agrees.

scenes.title: Who can see this?
scenes.caption: Every viewer and the exact path, checked against Jira
scenes.narration: Next: who can see PAY-3, and why? Three people, Alana, Kevin and the reporter, each with the exact access path through cd-staff-hq. The CD Developers role can browse the project, but the security level shuts it out. Every viewer is checked against Jira's own list, and it agrees.

scenes.title: Audit log
scenes.caption: Every action: who, when, inputs, result, duration
scenes.narration: Every call lands in the audit log on the admin page: who asked, which action, the result, and how long it took. Here is yesterday's run of the same question about Emma: the same verdict, word for word. Across our scripted test runs, thirty out of thirty answers were identical.

scenes.title: Sprawl audit and cleanup plan
scenes.caption: Explainable score; nothing is written without preview and confirmation
scenes.narration: How healthy is the configuration? Forty-two out of a hundred, from the latest scan of all twenty-five projects, with an explainable breakdown and ranked findings, each with evidence. Show the duplicate fields: five sets, each with field IDs and a recommendation. Now, create a cleanup plan in PAY for the top three findings. Config Doctor previews exactly what it would create, one epic and three tasks, and asks me to confirm. I say yes. Rovo then shows its own confirmation card, bound to a single-use token. Only after that click does it write: epic PAY-12 and three tasks, labelled and recorded in the audit log.

scenes.title: Change Impact Preview
scenes.caption: Read-only simulation before you change anything
scenes.narration: Before changing anything, simulate it. What happens if I remove group cd-contractors-2024? Medium risk. Max Taylor and Ryan Lee lose browse, create, edit and transition in both PAY and VEND. Emma Paris loses VEND, but keeps PAY through cd-dev-vn. It also lists every role and scheme that references the group. A read-only simulation: nothing in Jira is changed.

scenes.title: Demo Lab
scenes.caption: Try it on any site; removal deletes only what it recorded
scenes.narration: Judges don't need our seed scripts. On the admin page, the opt-in Demo Lab previews every object it will create, then builds a small, labelled scenario on your own site, using only your account. Try these: why can't I see CDLAB-2? Blocked by issue security, Jira agrees, and the fix shows its blast radius. Remove demo lab later deletes exactly what it recorded.

scenes.title: Works without Rovo
scenes.caption: Admin page: score, trend, findings, impact preview
scenes.narration: The admin page works even without Rovo: weekly scans and a trend, explainable findings, and the same impact preview. Config Doctor is read-only, apart from two opt-in writes: the Demo Lab, and confirmed cleanup plans.

scenes.title: Rovo MCP tools
scenes.caption: Any Rovo Studio agent can call the same tools
scenes.narration: Through Rovo MCP, any agent you build in Rovo Studio can call the same five tools. This draft agent has no instructions of its own, yet it answers correctly: Kevin cannot transition PAY-2, because only the CD Developers role can. The same deterministic code, wherever you ask.
Config Doctor for Jira. Code computes. Rovo explains.
